3mx

OOO «Trimiks» · ООО «Тримикс»

3mx is the trade name of OOO «Trimiks»RussianООО «Тримикс», registered in St Petersburg on 21.07.20231. It trades under the trademark «3mx», no. 11259672. Its owners and director have been hidden in the company register since 01.11.20241. It is under sanctions in Switzerland, EU, US and Ukraine3,4,5,6. Revenue in 2023: ₽45.6m7.

What this page does not show

  • The owners, directors and original name before the register was closed come from an investigator's dossier. They are graded Reported until a register extract from before that date confirms them.
  • The dossier names 5 further staff members. They are not listed here.
  • The Ukraine listing rests on a sanctions aggregator's match by tax number. The official list entry has not yet been read.
  • No listing date is recorded for Switzerland, US and Ukraine; those listings are not on the timeline.
  • No document records the company as a formal member of a TsBST programme. Its link to TsBST rests on the posts and statements cited here.
  • No foreign components in its products are documented.
  • No use of its products in the field is documented. Handovers to military units are reported by donors and do not show use.

Facts here come from documents: the company register, its filed accounts, the patent and trademark registers, sanctions lists and its own posts. Entries resting on anything weaker are marked Reported and named above.
